name: ckam-security-release-ccae7b2
purpose: CKAM emergency security release (IF-01 file-read fix and the security closure programme)
release_sha_note: release_sha / release_sha_short repeat release_commit / release_commit_short because ops/windows/deploy_ckam.ps1.template reads these two names to check that the package is the release it was asked to deploy
code_identical_note: git diff --name-only fd34520..ccae7b2 -- . ':!docs' lists exactly these four files; everything else outside docs/ is byte-identical to fd345202f127e9abe4d61390817e6064e926c2dd. Application code (backend/app, frontend) is unchanged; constraints.txt only adds colorama==0.4.6 (44 pins)
built_from: git archive of the committed tree ccae7b2 (no working-tree or untracked files)
frontend_build: npm ci; VITE_APP_VERSION=ccae7b2 npm run build; npm run check:build (OK)

security_migrations_in_order.what: asset_user.token_version (sessions end on access change); the new code cannot sign anyone in without it
TRUNCATE guards on the append-only tables; 5-year floor for the audit purge
auth_session table (refresh-token reuse detection, AU-06); must be applied before the new code starts
trigger trg_asset_lifecycle_fields_guard: asset.status / current_asset_user_id / status_since may only change through the ledger writer (OBS-STATUS)

migration_notes.one_transaction: alembic upgrade head runs all four migrations in ONE database transaction: a failed upgrade rolls back all four and leaves the database at e6f8a0b2c4d6 (confirm with alembic current)
migration_notes.old_release_on_new_schema: After c6e8a0b2d4f6 the OLD release 3b5e842 can still RECEIVE assets, but it CANNOT move, repair, mark lost/found, dispose, sell or scrap: the lifecycle trigger refuses those updates and the user sees a misleading HTTP 422. It also still has IF-01. Never use it as a quick rollback
migration_notes.new_release_on_old_schema: The new code on the un-migrated schema looks healthy (/api/health 200) but every sign-in fails: always migrate before starting it
migration_notes.policy: roll forward first (fix and redeploy); a database restore from the pre-deploy dump only by owner decision

components.backend/app/: production backend code incl. app/alembic (migrations); no tests, no __pycache__
components.backend/constraints.txt: exact runtime package versions, 44 pins incl. colorama==0.4.6 for Windows (IF-11)
components.backend/scripts/create_owner.py: one-time first-owner bootstrap script (only script shipped)
components.frontend-dist/: built frontend (no source maps, self-hosted fonts)
components.ops/windows/: reference launcher, deploy, verify and rollback scripts + README
components.ops/db/: role-split, verify and least-privilege check SQL + runbook, for the DBA (not used by this deploy)

zip_sha256: not stored inside the zip (a file cannot contain its own hash): see ../MANIFEST.sha256.txt next to the zip, which lists the SHA-256 of the zip and of every file in this folder
